verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's first-party Proxy documents real-time streaming of flag changes to connected apps. Flags can be toggled off per environment, including via an automatable toggle endpoint, which supports the kill-switch idea. However, streaming is documented only for JavaScript and React, and only through the Proxy, so delivery to the other SDKs is unevidenced. missing for 10: streaming or fast-polling support across non-JS SDKs, documented propagation latency (seconds), polling/refresh interval details, independent or hands-on confirmation that a kill switch takes effect promptly.
